name: section46-closure
cmd: set -euo pipefail; out=${SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR:?}; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$out/install.log" 2>&1; sha256sum kernel/kernel.ts core/counts.ts core/count-proof-scope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.ts core/count-closed-family.ts core/count-closed-family.test.ts > "$out/source-before.sha256"; bunx tsc -p . --noEmit > "$out/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/count-closed-family.ts core/count-closed-family.test.ts > "$out/lint.log" 2>&1; bun test core/count-closed-family.test.ts > "$out/tests.log" 2>&1; git init -q; bunx --bun commitlint --default-config --edit research/track-m/section46-closure-message.txt > "$out/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bunx --bun commitlint --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs --edit research/track-m/section46-closure-message.txt > "$out/historical-commitlint.log" 2>&1; sha256sum kernel/kernel.ts core/counts.ts core/count-proof-scope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.ts core/count-closed-family.ts core/count-closed-family.test.ts > "$out/source-after.sha256"; cmp "$out/source-before.sha256" "$out/source-after.sha256"; echo SECTION46_CLOSURE_PASS
